## Model Bench (Selva | AI Unhyped)
Sends the same test cases to two AI models, one at a time, and logs time, tokens, cost and a score.
1. Add your keys: **GPT-6 Astra** node = Header Auth `Authorization` / `Bearer YOUR_OPENAI_KEY`; **Gemini 4 Argon** node = Header Auth `x-goog-api-key` / `YOUR_GEMINI_KEY`.
2. Chapter 3 only: connect Google Drive and upload the 3 invoices from test-data.
3. Pick chapters in **Test Cases** (`CHAPTERS`) and run. Every run costs API money.
4. Results: open **Score** > Binary > download results.json.
